name: N8

images.credit: Dienthoaiquangcao68, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: Nokia 808 PureView, Nokia N9, Nokia Lumia 800, Nokia 8

Network.Technology: HSDPA (Pentaband) HSUPA 850 / 900 / 1700 / 1900 / 2100, Quad band GSM / GPRS / EDGE GSM 850, GSM 900, GSM 1800, GSM 1900

Platform.Operating system: Symbian^3, upgradeable to Nokia Belle Refresh (111.040.1511)
Platform.CPU: ARM11 680 MHz Samsung K5W4G2GACA – AL54 processor, 3D Graphics Broadcom BCM2727 GPU with HW Accelerator with OpenGL-ES 2.0 support

Memory.Storage: 512 MB internal NAND memory; 135 MB available to user, 16 GB on-board memory
Memory.Card slot: Hot swap microSD; up to 32 GB supported w/ microSDHC support

Display.Display: 210 ppi pixel density 640 × 360 nHD), 3.5" capacitive, multi-touch display with AMOLED technology

Cameras.Rear camera: 12.1 megapixels with Carl Zeiss optics and xenon flash, 16:9 720p video with continuous AutoFocus, 30 frame/s

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB 2.0 via MicroUSB, USB On-The-Go, Bluetooth 3.0, Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n, FM transmitter, TV-out, HDMI out with Dolby Digital Plus Surround Sound, GPS with A-GPS, 3G
